text: Returns the top N holders of the token named in the request, as JSON with fields: token (the requested symbol), as_of (Unix seconds), total_holders (integer), holders (array of exactly N objects with rank 1..N, address, balance, share_pct). Holders are sorted by balance, largest first. share_pct values are between 0 and 100 and their sum is at most 100. Refund: 100 percent for a wrong token, placeholder or invented data, an error message, or inconsistent figures; 20 percent for each holder row that is missing or invalid.
